Federated Learning for Low-Power Edge Devices

Priya Sharma, Member, IEEE, and Tom Becker

Abstract—Federated learning lets devices train a shared model without sharing data, but low-power devices struggle with the communication cost. We propose a compression scheme that cuts uplink traffic by 90% with less than 1% accuracy loss on three benchmark datasets.

Index Terms—Federated learning, edge computing, compression.

VI. CONCLUSION

We showed that aggressive update compression makes federated learning practical on low-power edge devices. Future work will study energy use on real hardware.
